title: Mixed Event — Happy Lovely Everyday! — Episode8 Airi Momoi the Idol

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! are delighted to receive a request to perform at an elementary school. With experience performing in children's variety shows under her belt, Airi enthusiastically starts planning for the event.

rows.Line: se_event_everyday_2021_003
Gym

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for inviting us here today, you guys!
se_event_everyday_2021_003

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be saying goodbye to this school, but I want you all to remember all the good times you had and have hope for tomorrow...! That's why I'm gonna put everything I have into this song!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Get ready because we're just getting started!!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
This song's so cute!
I really like it!

rows.Speaker: T-shirt Boy
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: T-shirt Boy
rows.Line: Happy Everyday's really a real idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, all together now!
Raise your hands in the air...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
This is nice...
QT Airi's solo song that never got a chance.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I still can't believe how you actually managed to get us permission to use this song, Shizuku! It's such a good song! A song meant for Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I just assumed it'd been locked away in the record company's vaults since she ended up leaving before it was finished...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But this song is also a reflection of how much Airi cared about QT... It really was designed and written just for her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure she wanted to see it through until the end.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're doing great, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I thought I had it all figured out, but it turns out I was completely wrong...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I thought I knew that an idol's an idol even if they're a variety idol.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I convinced myself somewhere along the way that idols have to sing and dance on a stage to inspire people and give them hope...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(But I know that's not true now.
Even if I get laughed at, even if I'm hardly ever on stage...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm an idol! I can be a source of hope!)
se_event_everyday_2021_007

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, everyone, make sure to look straight at the camera!

rows.Speaker: Cameraman
rows.Line: Okay, smile and say... Cheese!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: We all get a special MMJ yearbook, right?!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: I can't wait to get mine!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Phew...
We're finally done.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We just need to say goodbye to all the students and thank the teachers for taking over behind the camera...

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line: E-Excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, hi there.

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line: I'm a really big Happy Everyday fan! I asked my teacher to give you a message...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, that message was from...?

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line: Th-Thank you for coming today, Happy Everyday!

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line: My mom and dad always have to work really late, so I'm usually all alone at home most nights...

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line: But whenever I see you on TV, Happy Everyday, I forget all about feeling lonely.

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line: Even when I do feel that way, I can cheer myself up just by thinking about you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I...
I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh!
The Masked Variety Idol will always be there to help those who try their very best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whenever you feel down and out, come and see me! I'll help cheer you up and see how wonderful tomorrow is going to be!

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line:
Okay!
Thanks, Happy Everyday!

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line: I really like you as an idol too! You're the best, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Th-Th...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line:
Are you okay?!
Did you hurt yourself?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
N-No! Don't worry!
I'm okay, really!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not hurt or anything...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm just so happy right now...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you very much! From the bottom of my heart!
After the event
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Man, that was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It really was. Our stream did really well too, by the looks of it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, for our next video, we should talk about what happened behind the scenes during this event!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's a wonderful idea.
We can even mention some of the students who may've been left out by the camera.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We could even have you talk about what that girl told you at the end, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hold your horses...!
That doesn't need to be made public!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But Len was right.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I still managed to reach people...
Even back then.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I can't help but love you being Happy Everyday, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You really know how to inspire hope in all of us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I'm gonna keep spreading hope left and right from here on out!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Spread hope left and right?
Something about that feels a bit off...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, I'm just glad you feel better now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
And this event was so much fun even though it was our very first one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It'd be great to do something like this again...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It'd be great? No, Minori, we're gonna do something like this again for sure!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I want to keep doing more stuff for my fans! A lot more!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we're gonna keep trying more and more tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
